name: adv-06-double-claim
invariant: single-use claims (settlement); ClaimReceipt is a write-once nullifier
spec_refs: state-machine.md §2 transition 10 (claim_reward: no existing ClaimReceipt for that leaf / nullifier unused)
guard: claim_reward guard: there MUST be no existing ClaimReceipt for the reward leaf (its nullifier must be unused).
why_rejected: The second claim re-uses the same reward-leaf nullifier already recorded by the first ClaimReceipt. Accepting it would pay the same leaf twice (double spend of the reward budget).
